existing_evidence: Use exactly the already public 623-row/89-cell retained numeric matrix and frozen retrospective policy choices. No source acquisition, disassembly or native experiment is added.
motivation: R3 cannot identify a causal loop implementation effect independently of fixed execution position, and its full policy has no untouched test. This audit does not repair those gaps. It asks a new conditional identification question: for each declared magnitude of unknown adjacent-position drift, which rankings and regrets remain possible or guaranteed by the retained summaries?
model: For one cell, observed log timing x_p=theta_p+b_j(p), j is the fixed measured arm position; |b_(j+1)-b_j|<=delta, b_0=0 fixes an irrelevant common offset. theta_p is a counterfactual same-state log cost under THIS model. Drift may differ independently between cells. delta is NOT estimated or validated from these data. Additive log drift does not cover arbitrary path-by-state interactions, and it is not a physical clock model.
point_inputs: Every raw selected minimum, mean and maximum separately; retain primary formatted minima as a separate reproduction view. No per-repetition pairing, median, confidence interval or future population bound is inferred.
rectangle_inputs: Also x_p in [log raw min_p,log raw max_p] independently, as an observed-summary uncertainty rectangle. Sharpness is relative to THIS artificial uncertainty set; no claim these extrema co-occurred or cover future repetitions.
predicted_identities: For p!=q, sup(theta_p-theta_q)=log U_p-log L_q+delta*|j(p)-j(q)|. Self contrast is exactly zero, NOT log(U_p/L_p). Thus worst log regret for a fixed choice p is max(0,max_(q!=p)(log U_p-log L_q+delta*d_pq)). The minimax descriptive audit choice minimizes this value over p, using ALL within-cell measured arms; it is not a trained predictor or a deployable heldout policy. Candidate p can be a minimizer iff log L_p-log U_q<=delta*d_pq for all q, with the cone b_j=-delta*|j-j(p)| as a simultaneous witness. It is a guaranteed minimizer iff log U_p-log L_q+delta*d_pq<=0 for all q. Strict signs certify a unique winner. With no bounded drift assumption every candidate can be made optimal, despite narrow observed ranges.
planned_reports: All89-cell winner identification and peer/flat comparison breakdown by pattern; critical adjacent drift for each separated nominal winner; fixed original35-case retrospective-policy regret bounds with admitted19/unsupported16 groups; minimax descriptive audit regret envelope. Report each uncertainty model and grid point separately. No average effect or prevalence outside this chosen corpus.
independent_checks: Use a separately formulated scipy linear program on every ordered distinct arm pair in all89 cells at delta=log1.02 for both points and rectangles. Compare analytic pair support, regret and possible/guaranteed winner conditions against LP feasibility. Preserve full selected-input hash and source artifact bindings. Include singleton-arm and interval-self-contrast controls.
scientific_boundary: These are secondary arithmetic/optimization checks and sensitivity curves conditional on an unvalidated drift restriction, not new native evidence, order randomization, statistical uncertainty calibration, causal attribution, corrected hardware timing or untouched policy validation. Any future manuscript must preserve the R3 limitations and distinguish a material new conditional audit from a repaired acquisition.
